# GPU unlock 1.1.1 — RTX 4090 and experimental Ada GPUs

New to this project? Start with the [copy-paste Quick Start](QUICKSTART.md).

This Linux kernel module enables the SM speed-select override before the stock
NVIDIA driver starts. RTX 4090 (`10de:2684`, AD102) support has demonstrated
approximately **2× FP16 and BF16 tensor throughput with FP32 accumulation**:

| Mode | Before | After |
|---|---:|---:|
| FP16 → FP32 accumulate | 165.6 TF/s | 331.6 TF/s |
| BF16 → FP32 accumulate | 165.5 TF/s | 330.6 TF/s |

The override survived PCIe Function Level Reset (FLR), stock NVIDIA `615.78.08`
initialization and CUDA benchmarks. INT8, `dp4a` and scalar FP32 stayed near their
baseline rates. The original transaction preceded the repository cleanup; see
the [technical report](rtx4090-register-report.md) and
[original evidence](docs/evidence/rtx4090/README.md).

An independent owner run of revision `8855e7b` also completed the RTX 4090
transaction and NVIDIA driver handoff on Linux `7.2.11-arch1-1`. Matched
stock/unlocked measurements with NVIDIA `615.78.08` and the same 450 W cap
found FP16/FP32 instruction throughput **160.4 → 320.4 TF/s** and BF16/FP32
**159.7 → 320.2 TF/s**. All exercised numerical checks passed. Real cuBLAS
GEMM median throughput varied by shape: FP16 gained 12–34%, BF16 gained
16–20% at two shapes and was essentially unchanged at 4096³. These are one
matched run pair with the desktop active, not whole-application speedups or
an extended stability test. See the [matched evidence and limits](docs/evidence/rtx4090-pr1-matched/README.md)

# 3D Model Anything

[![Watch the video: 3D Model Anything](docs/images/thumb-1.png)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JGQCcCzuS88)

Capture a room on an iPhone, then use its geometry and photographs to build an editable Three.js scene with an AI coding agent.

[Open the office viewer](https://wesbos.github.io/3d-model-anything/) · [App support](https://wesbos.github.io/3d-model-anything/support.html)

This repository includes the **3D Model Anything iPhone app**, a **Three.js viewer**, the **scan-to-threejs agent skill**, and **Wes’s detailed office demo**.

The app records the evidence. The skill guides an agent through measurement, modeling and matched-camera visual comparisons. This is an iterative reconstruction workflow, not a one-click scan-to-perfect-model converter. The current workflow focuses on rooms and interiors.

## Run the viewer

Use Node.js 22.12+ (or a newer supported release).

```sh
npm ci
npm run dev
```

Open http://localhost:5188. Explore the office in dollhouse, walking, overhead, wireframe and knolling views. The playground is at `/play.html?room=office-v4&mode=fpv`.

```sh
npm run build
npm run preview
```

The demo includes the reconstructed office and selected textures. Original scans and photo collections are not distributed; Scan and Overlay are disabled for this example. Those modes remain available for your own rooms with reference assets.

See [the iPhone app](apps/house-capture/README.md) for building with Xcode, device requirements, scanning and sharing. Scanning needs a LiDAR-equipped iPhone or iPad. Non-LiDAR devices can import and review scans.

The app is source-available here; an App Store release is a separate distribution step. Do not assume an App Store download is available yet.

# The Day Trader skill

11 Claude skills for day trading: scan thousands of charts, track breaking news, time every entry and exit, and replay every outcome before you risk a dollar.

Free, MIT, no signup, no API key. The tools are plain Python that read free
public data: Yahoo Finance charts, Nasdaq Trader's symbol lists, SEC EDGAR
and the House Clerk.

One scans thousands of charts for setups. Another tracks breaking news on
every stock you watch. One watches a setup bar by bar and tells you the moment
to get in, and another sets your stop and your target before you do. And the
craziest one is the Time Machine: before you risk a dollar, it replays the
rest of the session 10,000 times from the stock's own recent bars, plus every
past day the same setup fired, and tells you the honest odds.

And no trade goes through until you say yes. Nothing in this pack can place
an order on its own. Paper trading is the default.

> **Looking for the original Trader skill?** Copy an investor's 13F, the
> stock screener, tax lots and rebalancing live in
> [github.com/Jakeschincariol/trader-skill](https://github.com/Jakeschincariol/trader-skill).
> This repo is its day-trading sequel: the Trader skill v2.

## Install

Paste this into Claude:

```
https://github.com/Jakeschincariol/day-trader-skill

install skill

Or as a plugin, in Claude Code:

```

Claude Code namespaces plugin skills, so installed as a plugin they show up as

name: hackios-xnu-kernel
readme:
# HakiOS

English · [中文](README.zh.md) · [Українська](README.uk.md)

HakiOS runs the open-source XNU kernel (xnu-8796.121.2) with my own boot loader and my own drivers
on an Android phone with a Qualcomm SoC, and boots the stock iOS 16.5 user space on top of it:
launchd, backboardd, SpringBoard, the apps. The same thing runs in QEMU (`virt`, aarch64) on a
Linux PC.

Nothing is flashed. The loader goes into RAM through `fastboot boot`, the system lives in RAM for
the length of a session, and a reboot brings the phone back to its own Android. This is a research
bench, not a ROM.

The first phone is the **POCO X5 Pro 5G** (`redwood`, Snapdragon 778G). The kernel knows nothing
about it in advance: every address, interrupt, power rail and firmware comes from the phone's own
device tree and its own Android, so a port to another Qualcomm phone is a new directory under
`devices/`, not a rewrite.

## What is in the repository

Only my code and my data:

- the kernel: a patch to Apple's open-source XNU (`xnu/hakios.patch`, APSL 2.0) and my driver
  files (`xnu/files/`), laid over a fresh clone by `xnu/apply.sh`;
- the boot loader (`xnuloader/`), my programs and libraries (`userland/src/`), tools (`tools/`),
  build and run scripts;
- `prebuilt/`: the kernel, loader and libraries built from this repository;
- `devices/poco-x5-pro/`: what one phone needs (its UEFI port, device tree, firmware script).

Not in the repository, never:

- any file of iOS: no binary, image, cache, font, picture or screenshot. You build the system
  image on your machine from the iOS 16.5 IPSW, which `sysimage/fetch.sh` downloads from Apple's
  public servers for you, without decrypting or circumventing anything;
- the phone's firmware (GPU, Wi-Fi, audio DSP, modem, haptics, cameras): it is the vendor's and
  is pulled from your own phone into `fw-*/`, which git ignores;
- keys, certificates, activation, or anything that would make the phone pass as an iPhone to

readme:
# php2shell - 官方环境 无需display_errors，不修改memory_limit

中文 | [English](readme_en.md) | [日本語](readme_ja.md)

**官方 prefork 配置（MaxRequestWorkers=150）下**，在完全远程、只用 HTTP、目标页面只有 `<?php echo "OK\n"; ?>`、不写目标侧
PHP 的约束下，一条命令拿到 RCE：

- stock 官方镜像 + 官方 ini + 官方 worker：**10/10**
- 单 worker 基线（早期标定/调试）：**20/20**
- 单次约 3–4 秒（含 149 个占位连接），被固定的 worker 不重启，目标 ini 未改

# 通用利用

理论上只要你计算出所有php版本的偏移，然后利用这些偏移批量去fuzz，总有一条fuzz是能rce的。反正worker崩了也会重启，不怕目标打挂。

关于 worker：官方 prefork 的 `MaxRequestWorkers=150` 也已打通。脚本先占住 149 个 worker 的未完成请求，再把 A1/B1/A2/B2 固定到剩下的同一个 child；单 worker 只是早期的调试形态（`--workers 1` 仍可复现）。

## 快速开始（官方 php.ini-production / display_errors=Off / 128M）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/9bie/php2shell-bypass-aslr-exp.git
cd php2shell-bypass-aslr-exp

# 1) 起目标：stock 官方镜像；容器里只把官方 php.ini-production 复制成 php.ini
./pure/run_pure.sh
# target: OK
# architecture: x86_64 (run exploit with --arch x86_64)
# PHP 8.4.26 ...
# display_errors => Off => Off
# memory_limit => 128M => 128M
# workers: official (run exploit with --workers 150)

# 2) 一条命令：A1 -> B1 泄漏 -> A2 -> B2 -> id
python3 exploit.py --port 18110
#       --arch auto（默认）：自动识别 x86_64 / aarch64
#       pinned 150/150 workers (149 holders)
# [try 1] A1: END-cleanup send_cookie OOM
# [try 1] B1: stale-id OOB read (chunk base + libphp)
#       arch=x86_64 decoded=819208 zval_ptr_dtor=0x7fe00ef5db60 -> libphp=0x7fe00e8ff000
#       chunk buckets: [('0x7fe00c600000', 7495), ('0x7fe00ee00000', 1095),
#                       ('0x7fe00cc00000', 87), ('0x7fe00c400000', 79)]
# [try 1] A2 + B2: main=0x7fe00cc00000 S=0x7fe00ccf8398 zif_system=0x7fe00ed64370
# [4/4] RCE OK; proof .../out/p1:
# uid=33(www-data) gid=33(www-data) groups=33(www-data)
```

不编译 PHP/Apache、不 build 镜像、不挂 gdb、不改目标 ini。
`pure/run_pure.sh` 默认容器 `p2s-pure-18110`、端口 `18110`，默认使用
官方 prefork 配置（MaxRequestWorkers=150），起完会打印实际架构、ini 和
MPM 值；`--single` 才挂非官方的单 worker 覆盖
`pure/docker/apache-single-worker.conf`（配合 `--workers 1`）。`docker/apache.conf`
只是给旧 harness 保留的兼容软链，指向同一个文件。

name: php2shell-checker
readme:
# PHP Version Checker

Get a version-based PHP2Shell warning from a website's PHP headers or local installation.

To install both skills, ask Codex:

```text
$skill-installer install both skills from https://github.com/openai/php2shell-checker
```

Use [phpcheck-server](skills/phpcheck-server/SKILL.md) when you have server
access, or [phpcheck-url](skills/phpcheck-url/SKILL.md) when you only have a URL:

```text
$phpcheck-url check https://example.com
```

```text
$phpcheck-server check the PHP version serving my site
```

## Run directly

Check a website:

```sh
node phpcheck.js "https://example.com"
```

## Results

| Result | Exit code | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OK` | `0` | Advertised version meets an upstream fixed release. |
| `POTENTIALLY VULNERABLE` | `1` | Advertised version is in an affected range. |
| `UNKNOWN` | `3` | Missing or unrecognized version, prerelease, or failed check. |

Use `--json` for machine-readable output. `patch_status` is `ok`,
`potentially_vulnerable` or `unknown`. Invalid arguments exit with code `2`.

Versions below a listed upstream fix return `potentially_vulnerable` and
exit `1`. PHP 5.4–5.6, 7.0–7.4, 8.0 and 8.1 also return this warning, even
with a higher patch number such as 8.1.35.

## URL checks

URL mode reads `X-Powered-By` and `Server`, sends `HEAD`, and falls back to
`GET` only when `HEAD` returns 405 or 501. It does not follow redirects or
inspect response bodies. Missing or hidden PHP headers return `UNKNOWN`.

The upstream fixed releases are 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27 and 8.5.12, from the
[October 21 PHP advisory](https://www.php.net/archive/2026.php#2026-10-21-5).
HTTP headers cannot tell whether the version contains a backported fix. Even `OK`
only describes the advertised version - it doesn't verify the installation!
The checker does not send exploit probes.

## Contributing

OpenAI is not accepting external code contributions to this project. Bug
reports and non-code feedback are welcome through GitHub issues.

name: Snapintosh
description: EL2 hypervisor and toolchain that boots macOS on the ASUS A16 (Snapdragon X2 Elite), with an Adreno Metal/IOGPU stack
readme:
# Snapintosh

![Snapintosh — macOS on Snapdragon; ASCII hands reaching toward a red chip](docs/assets/snapintosh-ascii-chip-red.png)

Snapintosh boots Apple's macOS 27 (build 26A428) on an ASUS Zenbook A16 laptop
with a Qualcomm Snapdragon X2 Elite (X2E-96-100). It is an EL2 monitor
(hypervisor) and the toolchain around it. The monitor runs Apple's stock
kernelcache (the J700/T8140 kernel) unmodified by default. It supplies the
platform contracts that the kernel expects from Apple silicon: the SPTM and TXM
monitor calls, translation of the kernel's 16 KiB page tables, and the Apple
devices the kernel looks for.

Graphics run on the laptop's own Adreno X2-90 GPU through a driver stack
written for this project:

- **AdrenoMetal.bundle**: a Metal driver plug-in.
- **AdrenoX2**: an IOGPU kernel extension, with **AdrenoDisplay** driving the
  internal panel.
- **air2ir3**: a shader compiler that translates Apple's AIR (Metal's IR) into
  Mesa's ir3 for the Adreno.

There is no software, CPU or paravirtual rendering path.

The project also includes an I2C-HID keyboard and touchpad driver (SnapI2CHID),
native QCC2072 Wi-Fi work, and NVMe storage through an emulated Apple storage
controller.

Snapintosh is used together with [q1n1](https://github.com/Snapintosh/q1n1), a
UEFI EL2 proxy forked from Asahi Linux's m1n1. q1n1 takes the machine at EL2
after UEFI and serves m1n1's proxy protocol over USB-C to a Mac host, which
drives Snapintosh from there.

## Status

This is experimental software, written for one laptop model.

| macOS desktop on the A16 | Boots to the desktop with GPU acceleration. Rendering is correct: the pixel checks across the desktop test scenes pass. |
| Smoothness | In progress. Interaction is usable but not yet smooth. The target is a steady ~60 Hz first and the panel's 120 Hz later. |

name: php2shell-scanner
description: High fidelity scanner for php2shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619)
readme:
# php2shell-scanner

A command-line tool for detecting CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 in PHP applications.

## How It Works

The scanner sends a minimal multipart control request followed by up to three crafted multipart probes. The probes use PHP array keys nested 62 levels deep and increase from 1 MiB to 20 MiB, matching the detection logic used by Assetnote's internal scanner.

A target is reported vulnerable when the probe produces a PHP memory-exhaustion error, a differential empty HTTP 500, a PHP-FPM worker failure, or an advertised PHP version known to be unpatched. Initial 5xx responses, common request-rejection statuses, and nonempty HTTP 500 responses without the PHP fatal-error signature are not treated as crash signals.

The scanner tests `/index.php` by default. A path supplied in the URL is preserved, and `--path` or `--path-file` can test custom paths. phpMyAdmin targets are automatically retested at `/show_config_errors.php`. Redirects are not followed unless `--follow-redirects` is set.

### SAPI Modes

The default `--sapi auto` mode applies both mod_php and PHP-FPM verdict rules, matching the combined behavior of Assetnote's postmodules. Use `--sapi mod_php` or `--sapi fpm` to restrict detection to a known SAPI.

### Network Impact

Each tested path may receive a 42-byte control request and three probes totalling about 29 MiB. Probing stops as soon as the verdict is settled, and duplicate input URLs are scanned once.

## Requirements

- Python 3.9+
- h11
- tqdm

## Installation

```
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

### Docker

Build the image:

```
docker build -t php2shell-scanner .
```

Run it with the same options as `scanner.py`:

```
docker run --rm php2shell-scanner -u https://example.com
```

Mount the current directory to read host lists and write results:

```
docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/data" -w /data php2shell-scanner -l hosts.txt -o results.json
```

## Usage

Scan a single host:

```
python3 scanner.py -u https://example.com
```

readme: # Beautiful Rust Three standard [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) and a lints config that teach coding agents to write, review, port, and enforce idiomatic Rust: - **`rust-best-practices`** loads whenever an agent writes or changes Rust, and steers it toward idiomatic, robust, maintainable code. - **`rust-review`** reviews existing Rust code, a file, a crate, or a diff, and writes a prioritized report where every finding cites the rule it breaks and shows the fix. - **`rust-port`** ports C, C++, Python, Go, or JavaScript to idiomatic Rust with the same behavior, porting the original tests first so you can prove the two match. - **`lints/`** is a drop-in clippy configuration that enforces the machine-checkable rules in CI. They work with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and any other agent that reads the Agent Skills format. name: neuron-explorer
description: Steering-first neuron explorer for Qwen3.5-4B: push every MLP neuron, keep every rollout, browse the results
readme:
# neuron explorer

Steering-first neuron explorer for Qwen3.5-4B. Every MLP neuron in a layer is pushed up and down on a few prompts, every
rollout is kept, and the explorer lays the results out over a 3D view of the model.

![neuron explorer](explorer.png)

## Explorer

    uv sync
    uv run python explorer/server.py        # http://localhost:8791

Reads sweep runs from `runs/` and per-layer stats from `stats/`, both produced by the sweep below; the caches in
`explorer/cache/` ship with the repo. Loads Qwen3.5-4B locally (MPS, CUDA or CPU) for live
steered chat, lens, connections and live inference over your own text.

- **map**: the model's layers in perspective, attention and MLP per layer, one point per neuron. Hover shows a neuron's
  steer lens and logit lens; click opens it; click a layer's label to view its sheet face-on. `writes` places
  neurons with similar down-projection columns next to each other.
- **list**: units ranked by word-cluster mass against random-direction controls; `lens` searches the steer and logit
  lenses for a token, `fires` runs your text through the model and filters neurons by activation.
- **neuron**: steered rollouts per prompt and dose, a three-column multi-turn steered chat (−, 0, +), lens and
  connections, and a name.
- **embeddings**: UMAP of a layer's rollouts, coloured by neuron, prompt, dose or kind.
- **Claude** (fourth neuron-panel tab, or the right-edge handle): a chat running the `claude` CLI (installed and
  logged in) with the explorer as an MCP server (`explorer/agent_mcp.py`). It reads neurons, cones and lenses, runs the
  live model (steering, activations, next-token logprobs, ablations), moves the map, list and highlights, and has file
  tools and a shell in your home folder. Its prompt is `explorer/agent_prompt.md` plus `explorer/agent_methodology.md`, and
  `explorer/agent_prompt.local.md` when present (untracked, for your own additions);
  `EXPLORER_CLAUDE_MODEL` picks the model. The server answers only pages

name: flare-local-inference
readme: > **Coding agents:** skip this README and read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) directly. Flare is a local inference server for NVIDIA SM120/SM121 GPUs, built for long conversations, coding agents, and repeated tool use. Its goal is to make the memory, bandwidth, and compute in workstations and compact systems such as DGX Spark go further, while keeping generation responsive. This is a research prototype, and is made available via open-source to enable technical collaboration and collect early feedback. The design rests on a few principles: - **Embrace the standard PyTorch ecosystem at build time; serve from Rust.** Ignition uses PyTorch, Transformers, and FlashInfer/b12x to load models, tune kernels, compile forwards, and capture CUDA graphs into a runtime package. Helios, the Rust runtime, serves that package without Python. Compilation and graph capture finish before serving. - **Build on the model ecosystem.** Reuse canonical model implementations wherever their dataflow fits, and specialize the parts that need different layouts or execution. Model development keeps the tools and libraries that make the Python ecosystem productive. - **Make memory and state explicit.** Plan buffers and execution capacities ahead of time. Treat conversation state—including recurrent state alongside KV caches—as a whole, so reuse, branching, and resuming preserve it correctly. - **Keep the runtime small and shared.** Model recipes own model computation; the runtime owns scheduling, cache storage, and request handling. A focused hardware and kernel stack keeps those boundaries manageable. [vLLM](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/) covers a much broader range of models, hardware, and deployment patterns. Flare trades that breadth for a focused serving contract around selected models and local workloads. Flare is not, and will never, be a rep

name: CleanFrame
description: A personal home screen for Samsung The Frame. A starting point to fork and adapt.
readme:
# CleanFrame

A quieter home screen for Samsung The Frame. Your apps, a photograph and the time, with an interface made for the TV remote.

![CleanFrame browser preview using the bundled Manrope font](docs/images/cleanframe-dock.jpg)

I built CleanFrame for one TV: my own Samsung The Frame, running Tizen. I'm sharing the code and setup notes as a starting point for other people to build on.

**Use it at your own risk.** Most of the work has gone into making it work well on my TV. Very little has gone into making it portable. The setup scripts reflect my computer, TV and firmware, so expect to adapt them and test the result on your own hardware.

I highly recommend forking it and building on top of it, ideally with a coding agent that can help you understand and adapt the setup. Start with the browser preview, make the interface your own, then work through TV installation when you're ready. Native Home/startup changes need particular care; the setup guide covers the risks and recovery steps.

## Try the interface

You need Node.js 22+ and Python 3.10+ to run the browser preview.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/nthnclrk/CleanFrame.git
cd CleanFrame
npm ci
npm run dev:public
```

Open [localhost:4795/home/](http://localhost:4795/home/). Use the arrow keys, Enter and Escape, or click the controls. App launches and Samsung screens require a TV; the preview reports that limitation when you select them.

The public preview uses the included Manrope, Geist and Newsreader fonts.

## What you can change

- Choose a List or Dock layout, with icons, names or both.
- Use a photograph, light or dark background, with a simple 12-hour clock.
- Adjust typography, focus and glass materials through the same Settings interface.
- Choose and reorder Home apps; discover installed apps on the TV.
- Select from fifteen wallpapers and save your preferences locally.

The glass and blur are rendered ahead of time. The TV loads the finished images and uses transforms and opacity for focus

name: gdirect
description: Rust Google Drive direct downloader using pinned libaria2
readme:
# gdirect

[中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

gdirect browses, downloads, uploads and mounts your Google Drive from the terminal. It finds Google IPs that are reachable from your network and sends Drive traffic straight to them, with multi-connection, resumable downloads.

## How it works

| Traffic | Route |
| --- | --- |
| Drive API, downloads, uploads (`browse`, `ls`, `download`, `upload`) | A scanned Google IP. The hostname and certificate check stay the same. If connections carrying the real SNI are reset, gdirect automatically retries under a forged identity (`g.cn` as TLS name, the real host in the Host header) — same idea as Sheas-Cealer — and remembers what worked per IP |
| Sign-in and token refresh (`oauth2.googleapis.com`) | Your normal system network (DNS, proxy) |
| `mount` (rclone) | Your normal system network |

The first transfer command scans candidate IPs automatically and keeps the fastest working one for 24 hours. `login` and `mount` do not scan. Each candidate is probed with the real SNI first, then with the forged identity, so the stored route always reflects what actually connects. Certificates are verified against Google's own GTS roots (embedded in the binary), never against a system CA bundle — a compromised third-party CA cannot impersonate Google for gdirect.

Network requirements:

- Sign-in and token refresh must reach `oauth2.googleapis.com` through your system network. If Google is blocked, you still need a proxy or VPN for this.
- If you use a TUN-mode proxy or VPN (for example Clash/Mihomo TUN), route the scanned Google IPs **DIRECT** and turn off fake-ip for them. Otherwise gdirect's traffic is captured again and the scan finds nothing. `gdirect scan --list` shows the IPs.

## Install

Prebuilt for macOS 15+ (Apple Silicon / Intel), Linux x86_64 with glibc 2.35+ (Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+, recent Fedora/Arch/openSUSE), and Windows x86_64. Alpine/musl, older glibc and Linux ARM64 need a [source build](#build-from-so

readme:
# SuperMimic reproduction on Isaac Lab 3 (kit-less, MuJoCo-Warp)

**Unofficial** reproduction of *SuperMimic: Scaling Humanoid Whole-Body Control with One Differentiable World
Model* (arXiv 2610.28480) — no official code is released, so everything here is implemented from
the paper. Target experiment: the controlled LAFAN1 comparison (Fig. 4a): 40 G1-retargeted LAFAN1
clips (2.45 h), one GPU; the paper reaches evaluation normalized return 0.82 after 1.2 h on an H100.

Author: **Chong Zhang** (ETH Zurich). License: [MIT](LICENSE).

> **Disclaimer:** this repository was speed-vibecoded in 1 hour with an AI coding
> assistant. It
> deliberately does not live under any lab's organization, because the code is too much "slop"
> for that: fast and unreviewed. Use it at
> your own risk.

> **One G1 motion tracker for all 40 LAFAN1 clips, trained in only ~1.5 GPU-hours**
> (1.47 h on a single RTX PRO 6000): evaluation return **0.829** with **0/40 failed clips**.
> For scale, the paper's PPO-in-simulator baseline does not reach return 0.82 within 18 h on up to
> 8 GPUs.

![SuperMimic G1 tracking LAFAN1 motions](results/supermimic_lafan1_highlight.gif)

*Solid robot: the trained policy simulated in Isaac Lab with MuJoCo-Warp. Blue ghost: the reference
motion. Clips: dance, jumps, fall-and-get-up, sprint.*

Progress and timestamps: [MILESTONES.md](MILESTONES.md).

## Layout

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `IsaacLab/` | Isaac Lab `main` @ 46d6cc3 (VERSION 3.0.0), unmodified — cloned by `tools/setup.sh`, not tracked |
| `docker/` | `Dockerfile`: `supermimic:latest` = `isaac-lab-kitless:main-46d6cc3` (built from `IsaacLab/docker/Dockerfile.kitless`) + tmux, ffmpeg, gcc (for `torch.compile`); `run_container.sh` |
| `data/` | not tracked; `tools/download_data.sh` fetches LAFAN1 G1 retargets (HF `lvhaidong/LAFAN1_Retargeting_Dataset`) and the G1 URDF/meshes, then builds `g1_29dof.xml` (MJCF) and the USD |
| `supermimic/` | implementation (see below) |
| `tools/` | setup, asset conversio

readme:
# ex-USSR Kinship Research

![ex-USSR Kinship Research cover](docs/cover.jpg)

**An evidence-first genealogy skill for AI agents (Codex, Claude Code and other Agent Skills runtimes).** It turns an agent into a careful family-history researcher for the former USSR, the Soviet Union and the Russian Empire. The agent reads church books and civil records, military, deportation and repression files, and unindexed archive scans. It keeps every find traceable, separates records from interpretation and says plainly what is proven and what is not.

Coverage includes all 15 former Soviet republics: Russia, Ukraine, Belarus, Moldova, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan and Uzbekistan. Archives are chosen by the event's historical jurisdiction and current record custodian; a regional example does not replace local research.

The skill's instructions are written in Russian, but **the agent talks to you in your language**: English, Ukrainian, Russian, Polish, German and so on. It quotes sources in their original spelling with a translation, and builds search queries in the languages of the records.

---

## What it does

- **Case intake and scope.** One research question, known facts, who may be alive, what is off-limits.
- **Reproducible registers.** Persons, artifacts, claims, relationships and a full search log (CSV), plus a final report template.
- **Historical jurisdiction model.** It resolves every event to the state, province, district, parish or civil registry *as of the event date*, not today's map.
- **Name-variant matrices.** Pre-reform Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Romanian, German and Yiddish forms, patronymics, maiden names and transliterations.
- **Source strategy.** Originals first, then official catalogs, indexes, published document collections, and only then trees and forums as leads.
- **Evidence protocol.** Claims get explainable statuses, not percentages: `hypothesis`, `single-source`, `corr

readme: # Motion For Anything You Draw For designers and engineers who want to bring their apps and drawings to life. Making a drawing move is easy. Making it feel alive is hard: it has to breathe, look around, blink, shift its weight and act, without ever freezing or jumping. This skill helps your agent get there. It started as the method I used to bring the illustrations in my app to life, and grew into a way to animate anything drawn: characters and creatures, plants, cloth, fire, smoke, water, weather, lights, machines, icons, logos, charts and whole scenes. The animation above is drawn and animated entirely in code, with the templates in this repo. ## Install ```bash npx skills@latest add rossark0/rossark-motion-skill ``` ## Why use it? Agents don't animate like animators. Ask an agent to bring a character to life and it will often swap one drawing for another, so the face teleports from one expression to the next. It moves through each pose with its own eased tween, so the body stops dead at every pose. Everything moves in sync, like a machine. Blinks are so short they flicker, everything bounces, and a thin line shows across the face where two shapes meet. All these small things add up, and the result looks like a slideshow instead of something alive. This skill lists those mistakes and how to fix them: one clock for the whole scene, parts that turn around their real pivots, trailing parts that follow a beat later, idle life that never stops, smooth paths through key poses, small amplitudes and strong curves. When you have a reference video, it measures the motion frame by frame before building, because what makes a reference feel alive is often too small to see. readme:
# xss-audit

Comprehensive XSS vulnerability detection skill with 14 layers of checks for React/TypeScript/JavaScript codebases (static audit). Use when the user wants an in-depth XSS audit with broad static coverage, including SVG, MathML, CSS injection, markdown pipelines, mXSS/sanitizer bypass, JSON-in-script injection, URL validation bypass, and Trusted Types analysis. Outputs report to xss-audit-report.md.

> Static analysis only. A search match is not a confirmed vulnerability.

## Background

This skill comes from my hands-on work in real-world bug bounty
programs. Over the course of one year, I used it in my day-to-day
audit workflow and refined it continuously based on what worked
and what missed. That workflow helped me identify dozens of XSS
vulnerabilities that were awarded bounties.

During the same period, I was ranked in Microsoft's MSRC Security
Researcher Leaderboard (quarterly Top 10) for four consecutive
quarters — 2025 Q3 #4, Q4 #7, 2026 Q1 #6, Q2 #10
([leaderboard](https://msrc.microsoft.com/leaderboard), [my profile](https://x.com/SecBoxer)).

I'm sharing it so others can adapt the same review process to
their own audits.

## Installation

Copy this directory into your agent's skills directory:

```text
<skills-directory>/xss-audit/SKILL.md
```

## Usage

```text
/xss-audit
/xss-audit src/
```

Or use `$` if that is your agent's skill syntax:

```text
$xss-audit
$xss-audit src/
```

## What it checks

The 14 review layers cover:

1. DOM and HTML injection: `innerHTML`, `outerHTML`, `insertAdjacentHTML`, `document.write`, `DOMParser`, `setHTMLUnsafe`, shadow DOM, and React `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`.
2. Attributes and event handlers: dynamic `on*` handlers, `href`, `src`, `srcdoc`, `action`, `formaction`, `style`, and JSX props that forward attacker-controlled values.
3. URLs and navigation: `window.open`, `location`, router navigation, protocol allowlists, hostname and substring validation errors, parser normalization, and downstream use of Hist

# ub-mode

`ub-mode` is an agent skill that enforces disciplined software engineering principles when writing or changing code. It is loosely based on portions of [@poteto](https://github.com/poteto)'s rules (`poteto-mode` / `pstack`), reduced and paired with deterministic quality-gate tools:

1. **First Make it Work** — Laziness Protocol, Foundational Thinking, TDD, Redesign From First Principles, Attack the Premise, Subtract Before You Add, Outcome-Oriented Execution, Build the Lever, and Architecture (Model the Domain, Boundary Discipline, Type System Discipline, Make Operations Idempotent, Separate Before Serializing Shared State).
2. **Then Make it Right** — Fix Root Causes, Sequence Work into Verifiable Units, Test Behavior (Not Implementation), [Crapper](https://github.com/unclebob/crapper) (`CRAP < 10`), [Dryer](https://github.com/unclebob/dryer) (duplication `< 0.8`), [Mutator](https://github.com/unclebob/mutator) (cover the uncovered, kill the survivors, delete dead code), and Refactoring.
3. **Practice** — Keep a Log, Guard the Context Window, Worktree Cleanup, and Commit and Push in small ordered commits.

## Companion Tool Repositories

`ub-mode` relies on deterministic quality-gate tools to enforce structure, complexity, duplication, and test thoroughness:

- [unclebob/crapper](https://github.com/unclebob/crapper) — Computes cyclomatic complexity, test coverage, and CRAP score per function so every function stays under the CRAP threshold (`< 10`).
- [unclebob/dryer](https://github.com/unclebob/dryer) — Detects structural code duplication so duplicate blocks (`>= 0.8` similarity) are eliminated.
- [unclebob/mutator](https://github.com/unclebob/mutator) — Runs mutation testing to expose uncovered code and surviving mutants that tests fail to catch.
- [unclebob/uml-viewer](https://github.com/unclebob/uml-viewer) — Visualizes components, coverage, CRAP, mutation scores, and dependency directions.

name: raven
description: A Windows your apps recognize.
readme:
A Windows your apps recognize.

[Website and documentation](https://useraven.org) Raven runs Windows applications on Linux. You install them with their own installers, the same ones you would use on a PC, and they start: no virtual machine, no winetricks, no DLL overrides. The program's code runs directly on your CPU, inside a sandbox where it cannot reach Linux. Every call it makes to the system is answered by Raven, which plays the part of the Windows kernel and its services: processes and threads, files, the registry, windows and input. Graphics go to Wayland and Vulkan, with DXVK and vkd3d-proton for Direct3D. ## Requirements - Linux on x86_64 - CMake 3.20 or newer, a C++20 compiler and Python 3.11 or newer - MinGW-w64 for x86_64 and i686, to build the Windows test programs - For desktop applications: Wayland, xkbcommon, pixman, FreeType and Vulkan - Optionally, for the experimental X11 desktop: libxcb with its xkb, xfixes and xinput extensions, and xkbcommon-x11 The tested setup also uses libpng 1.6.59, a CPU build of Skia with the Liberation fonts, DXVK and vkd3d-proton; the `scripts/provision-*.py` tools download the pinned versions. ## Installation Raven is built from source for now: ```sh git clone https://github.com/mirkobrombin/raven.git cd raven cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo cmake --build build -j2 ``` Then run an installer, or any program: ```sh export RAVEN_PREFIX="$HOME/.local/share/raven/my-app" build/native/raven --run-process --execution=native --timeout-ms=600000 --desktop=wayland setup.exe ``` On an X11 session, `--desktop=x11` takes the place of `--desktop=wayland`. The X11 desktop is experimental; `-DRAVEN_DESKTOP_WAYLAND=OFF` builds Raven without Wayland at all. `RAVEN_PREFIX` is the Windows installation the program sees, with its own `C:` drive and registry; give each application its own. Raven takes a snap

# Quiet Tizen

A practical, agent-readable guide to making a Samsung Tizen TV quieter and
more useful as an HDMI display.

This project documents work performed on one **Samsung UN75U8000FFXZA (2025
U8000F)**. It includes **Quiet Home**, a native launcher with a colorful,
English-language interface, lightweight settings, local app cards and a
shortcut to native Bluetooth controller pairing.

![Quiet Home layout illustration](docs/quiet-home-preview.svg)

*Layout illustration with the public text-only app cards. Input labels are configurable.*

It also includes targeted cleanup profiles, source-build tools and rollback
recipes. **It is a working case study with a reusable toolkit, not a universal
installer or a replacement operating system.**

## Give this repository to your coding agent

Clone the repository, open it in Codex, and use:

> Read README.md and AGENTS.md, then inspect the documentation before touching
> my TV. Help me reproduce Quiet Tizen on a TV I own. First identify its exact
> model, firmware and runtime, compare them with the tested profile, and show
> me any compatibility gaps. Keep HDMI, sound, networking, Bluetooth and
> accessibility working. Prefer HDMI and minimize smart features; keep the
> streaming apps I choose. Back up my actual settings and prepare rollback
> before each change. Install and verify Quiet Home before assigning it to
> Home/startup or replacing the slow settings sidebar. Use the measured
> findings and known limitations rather than assuming every package is spyware
> or promising a particular speed improvement.

cleanup compatibility.

name: mcd-money-saver
description: 基于麦当劳MCP的智能省钱助手
readme:
# 麦麦省钱助手（McD Money Saver）

> 花最少的钱，吃得麦满意。🍔

「麦麦省钱助手」是一个基于**麦当劳 MCP 能力**构建的智能省钱 Skill，帮助你把散落在各处的优惠券、麦麦省券、积分和套餐组合自动盘清楚，算出每一单最省钱的点法。

本作品为 **麦当劳程序员节创意开发大赛** 参赛项目，使用腾讯 **WorkBuddy** 辅助开发。

---

## 💡 它解决什么问题

每次点麦当劳，你是不是也纠结过这些问题？

- 手里攥着好几张券，哪张最划算？能不能叠加？
- 麦麦省又有新券可以领了，我领没领？
- 预算只有 30 块，该怎么点才能吃饱又不超支？
- 想控制热量，又不想错过优惠。

**麦麦省钱助手把这些事全包了**：先摸清你的券 → 帮你领 → 比价 → 算最优组合 → 给你一个明确的"省了多少钱"的答案。

## ✨ 核心功能

| 功能 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| 🎫 智能领券 | 一键领取麦麦省所有可领优惠券（`auto-bind-coupons`） |
| 🧾 最优组合 | 结合优惠券，算出"省钱最多"的套餐/餐品组合 |
| 💰 预算点餐 | 固定预算内，找最省钱又不超支的点法 |
| 🔥 热量搭配 | 控制热量的同时，仍帮你找最优价格 |
| 📊 积分查询 | 查积分余额，结合积分兑换省钱 |

## 🧠 工作原理

基于麦当劳 MCP 的多工具编排，流程如下：

```
查附近门店 → 查我的券/可领券 → 领券 → 查菜单 → calculates-price 比价 → 输出最优方案
```

详细工具调用说明见 [`MCP_INTEGRATION.md`](./MCP_INTEGRATION.md)。

## 📦 安装方法

### 前置条件

1. 申请麦当劳 MCP Token：前往 [open.mcd.cn/mcp](https://open.mcd.cn/mcp)，手机号登录 → 控制台 → 激活，一键复制 Token。
2. 一个支持 Streamable HTTP 的 MCP Client（推荐 **WorkBuddy**）。

### 接入麦当劳 MCP

在 MCP Client 中添加如下配置（把 `YOUR_MCP_TOKEN` 换成你的真实 Token）：

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "mcd-mcp": {
      "type": "streamablehttp",
      "url": "https://mcp.mcd.cn",
      "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_MCP_TOKEN"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

> 脱敏示例见 [`mcp-config.example.json`](./mcp-config.example.json)。

### 安装本 Skill

- **WorkBuddy**：将本仓库中的 `SKILL.md` 放入你的技能目录，或在对话中直接导入。
- 其他 Client：参考其 MCP Skill 导入方式，将 `SKILL.md` 作为 Agent 提示词加载。

## 🚀 使用示例

### 示例 1：预算内最省钱

> 用户：我只有 30 块，想吃顿麦当劳。
>
> 麦麦省钱助手：附近 3 家门店中，XX 店可用「满 30 减 5」券。推荐「麦辣鸡腿堡套餐」原价 ¥35 → 用券后 ¥30，帮您省了 ¥5，还送一杯可乐。要下单吗？

### 示例 2：薅羊毛

> 用户：看看我能领什么券。
>
> 麦麦省钱助手：已为您一键领取 3 张麦麦省券：「大薯条买一送一」「早餐卡 5 折」「麦辣鸡翅 8 折」。其中「早餐卡 5 折」用在早餐套餐上最划算。

### 示例 3：热量可控

> 用户：控制在 500 大卡以内，能省就省。
>
> 麦麦省钱助手：为您搭配「双层吉士汉堡 + 零度可乐」共 480 大卡，叠加「满 20 减 3」券后 ¥19，比单点省了 ¥6。

## 🎯 目标用户

- 学生党、打工人：预算有限，想吃饱又别超支
- 薅羊毛达人：下单前必看有没有券
- 健身减脂人群：控热量 + 要优惠

## 📁 项目结构

```
mcd-money-saver/
├── SKILL.md                  # Skill 定义（核心，省钱逻辑提示词）
├── README.md                 # 项目介绍（本文件）
├── CONTEST_DECLARATION.md    # 参赛声明（官方模板，不可修改）

description: Tool to dump unencrypted romFS and exeFS for Switch 2 games
readme:
# OunceCake

(`ozdumptool` if you're ***lame*** and ***boring***) 

Tool to dump unencrypted romFS and exeFS for Switch 2 games, updates and DLC.

Supports digital games, game cards, Switch 2 Editions, etc.

## Disclaimer

For the love of God, do NOT share any files you rip using this tool. It is to be used with ONLY your own games on your OWN system. This tool doesn't provide system keys or any method to decrypt files. The files are loaded normally by the system, then pulled over FTP.

## Usage

0. Take note of your Switch 2's local IP address. It can be found in the network settings.

1. Clone the repo: 
``` 
git clone https://github.com/misshexa66/OunceCake.git
```

2. Use kurumuz's fork of the [ns2jb exploit](https://gitlab.com/kurumuz/ns2jb) to get an RPC connection with the system. Use `node run.cjs --rpc`.

3. Run `node ouncecake.cjs <path-to-ns2jb-run>`. The output from ns2jb will tell you where this path is. (`Run folder: /home/hexa/projects/ns2jb2/runs/switch2-Icu7Jd`)

4. OunceCake will prompt you to pick a game. Pick one, then wait.

5. When OunceCake says `FTP up! ftp://<switch 2 ip>:2121`, use an FTP client to connect to your Switch 2's local IP address with port 2121. A username and password is not required. (Make sure your FTP client has its transfer mode set to Binary/Image/TYPE I.)

## Licensing

OunceCake is licensed under the terms of the GPLv2 (because it borrows a tiny bit of code from [Atmosphere](https://github.com/Atmosphere-NX/Atmosphere))

You can find a copy of the license in the LICENSE file.

# php2shell vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) Operational information: 21 October 2026 17:25 CEST
Software list last status update: 26 October 2026 03:08 CET
## TLP:CLEAR This repository contains operational information regarding the critical PHP vulnerabilities tracked by CERT-EU as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619. PHP is a widely used open-source server-side scripting language, so these vulnerabilities may affect a broad range of internet-facing web applications and products that embed or depend on PHP. ## Current status On 21 October 2026, PHP published fixed releases for CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619: PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35. PHP states that both vulnerabilities can allow unauthenticated remote code execution and that all PHP installations serving web requests are at risk, including PHP-FPM, Apache with mod_php, php-cgi, FrankenPHP and LiteSpeed. PHP considers the risk highest for mod_php, where an unauthenticated request can trigger exploitation before application code runs. PHP describes CVE-2026-109618 as remote code execution via out-of-memory corruption during request cleanup, and CVE-2026-109619 as remote code execution via stale request-owned global state reused by a later request on the same worker. PHP 8.1 and older are no longer supported by the PHP project; distributions and LTS vendors may provide backported packages, and PHP has published minimal source backports for PHP 7.4, 8.0 and 8.1. # Ming Voice **A fully local, real-time voice assistant for AMD Radeon GPUs (NVIDIA experimental), on Linux or Windows.**
Talk to it and it answers out loud, usually starting **about a quarter of a second** after you stop talking. [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/JMS1717/ming-voice?color=7f9cff)](https://github.com/JMS1717/ming-voice/releases) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-34d399)](LICENSE) ![ROCm 7.2](https://img.shields.io/badge/ROCm%207.2-Linux%20%7C%20WSL2-ed1c24?logo=amd&logoColor=white) [![Donate with PayPal](https://img.shields.io/badge/Donate-PayPal-00457C?logo=paypal&logoColor=white)](https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/jasonselsley)
Ming Voice turns [inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-audio-tiny](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-audio-tiny), a speech-to-speech model, into an assistant you can leave running at home. name: ian-xhs-carousel
description: 把文章、案例或笔记排成 3:4 小红书图文 | 1080×1440 | 20 个母版 | 浅色 / 深色 | Claude Code Skill
readme:
# Ian XHS Carousel

**中文** | [English](README.en.md)

> 把文章、案例或笔记，排成一组 3:4 的小红书图文。
>
> 1080×1440 竖版 | 20 个母版 | 浅色 / 深色 | Claude Code Skill

---

## 这是什么

Ian XHS Carousel 是一个 AI Skill，把你的内容做成一组小红书轮播图，风格是简洁的产品界面风。

你把内容交给它，它先出一张分镜表给你确认，确认后再排版、出图。

**最好用 Claude 跑。**

---

## 适合谁用

- 写文章、做案例拆解，想顺手发一份小红书图文的人
- 做 AI、产品、设计、效率工具内容，图里常有截图、步骤、对比、数据、代码的人
- 想让每期图文风格统一、看着干净的人

想要手绘、插画、大色块海报这类风格的话，这个不太合适。

---

## 它会产出什么

- **分镜表**：每页讲什么、用哪个母版、标题怎么写，先给你确认
- **每页一张 PNG**：1080×1440，可以直接发
- **总览图**：所有页排在一起，一眼看整组节奏
- **HTML 源文件**：想自己改字、换图，改完重新渲染就行

浅色、深色两版都能出，版式一样。

小红书帖子的标题、正文和话题标签需要你另外写。

---

## 20 个母版

![20 个母版 · 浅色](examples/images/templates-light.png)

<details>
<summary>深色版</summary>

![20 个母版 · 深色](examples/images/templates-dark.png)

</details>

| 分组 | 母版 |
|---|---|
| 封面 | T01 对话框、T02 窗口、T03 通知 |
| 讲做法 | T04 步骤、T05 清单、T06 时间线 |
| 对比 | T07 对错、T08 前后双栏 |
| 展示 | T09 宫格、T10 截图标注、T11 手机截图、T12 应用列表 |
| 数字 | T13 数据指标、T14 参数设置 |
| 文字 | T15 观点大字、T16 聊天、T17 提示词、T18 代码 |
| 结尾 | T19 对照、T20 完成 |

20 个都不合适的时候，AI 会用同一套样式拼一个新排法。

---

## 安装

**1. 下载并复制到 Claude Code**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/helloianneo/ian-xhs-carousel.git
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
cp -R ./ian-xhs-carousel/ian-xhs-carousel ~/.claude/skills/
```

**2. 装渲染要用的工具**（第一次用时装一次）

```bash
pip install playwright pillow
playwright install chromium
```

渲染时会联网加载英文和代码字体，记得保持网络畅通。

---

## 素材要好看

一组图好不好看，很大程度看你给的素材。上传前花几分钟挑一挑：

- **截图**：用高清的，裁掉浏览器工具栏、桌面和别的窗口；做深色版就截深色模式的
- **Logo 和图标**：用官方的 SVG，别截一个小图再放大
- **照片和效果图**：一堆里挑最好看的那张
- **没有好图**：先空着，它会在分镜表里列出来问你要，别拿糊的凑

---

## 怎么用

在 Claude Code 里输入：

```text
/ian-xhs-carousel 把下面这篇文章做成一组小红书图文。

<粘贴文章>
```

不输命令也行，直接说"把这篇做成小红书"，它一般会自己用上。

**只要分镜表**

```text
/ian-xhs-carousel 先别排版，帮我看看下面这篇能做成几页，出分镜表就行。

<粘贴文章>
```

**出深色版**

```text
/ian-xhs-carousel 把这篇做成小红书图文，用深色主题。截图在 ./shots 里。

<粘贴文章>
```

**改某一页**

```text
第 3 页换成 T08 前后双栏，左边放旧版截图，右边放新版。
```

更多示例见 [examples/prompts.md](examples/prompts.md)。

---

## 工作流程

1. **读内容**：想清楚这组图要让人带走什么
2. **出分镜表**：一页讲一件事，一般 5 页左右，**停下来等你确认**
3.

name: video-editor-skills
description: Skills that teach Claude Code to be a first-pass video editor in DaVinci Resolve: transcript cuts, vlog pacing, B-roll, music & SFX, clean captions, motion graphics, YouTube export. CC BY-NC 4.0 (no commercial use).
readme:
# Video Editor Skills for Claude Code

Turn Claude Code into a **first-pass video editor** for your YouTube vlogs and classes in **DaVinci Resolve Studio**. You film and make the taste calls; Claude imports, cuts retakes and dead air, keeps your B-roll, scores the video, writes clean captions, adds brand motion graphics and helps you export.

These are **skills only**: the method, the numbers, the rules and the traps, learned on real edits. There is no code in this package. Claude reads the skills and builds the small scripts with you, for your setup.

## What's inside

| Skill | Teaches Claude |
|---|---|
| `video-editor-setup` | the workspace, safe key handling, your Resolve template, which scripts to build |
| `edit-video` | the one-command flow: ingest → cut → build in Resolve → report |
| `rough-cut` | what to keep: retakes, false starts, notes to the editor, punchlines |
| `vlog-pacing` | silence detection, pads, pause rules, room at scene edges, jump-cut zoom |
| `broll` | finding and watching B-roll, cutting it by action and story |
| `resolve-scripting` | what works in the Resolve API, what silently fails, what crashes it |
| `voice-and-audio` | loudness normalize, diagnosing a muffled voice, EQ recipe |
| `music-and-sound` | Epidemic Sound cues per section, ducking envelope, tasteful SFX |
| `captions` | clean, correct, one-line captions read before import |
| `motion-overlays` | a Remotion brand kit timed to your words, face- and caption-safe |
| `figma-roundtrip` | design the kit in Figma, keep code and boards in sync |
| `youtube-export` | Deliver settings for great quality without 25 GB files |

Plus `templates/config.example.json` (starting values) and `LEARNINGS.md`, the story of what went wrong and how it was fixed.

## Install

**As a plugin** (keeps the skills together):
```
/plugin install <path-or-git-url-to-this-folder>
```
**Or copy the skills** into your project (`.claude/skills/`) or your user folder (`~/.claude/skills/`):
```
cp -R skills/*

readme:
# voxcpm2-turkce-ses-tasarimi

**Turkish voice design with VoxCPM2 on a 4 GB GPU.** Describe a voice in English, let the model create it, pick the
variant you like, then read any Turkish text with that voice. Includes a one-command installer, a patched
[audio.cpp](https://github.com/0xShug0/audio.cpp) engine that fits a GTX 1050 Ti (4 GB), a tiny local web UI and fourteen
ready-made synthetic voices: seven Turkish and seven native narrators in English, French, German, Spanish,
Russian, Chinese and Japanese (8 languages in total).

[Türkçe README](README.tr.md) · [How it fits in 4 GB](docs/4gb.md) · [macOS](docs/mac.md) · [Install guide for AI agents](AGENTS.md) · [Responsible use](ETHICS.md)

> The bundled voices are synthetic, designed from a text description. The voice cloning section is only for your own
> voice or a voice used with its owner's explicit permission; the UI asks you to confirm that permission. Impersonation,
> fraud and deception are prohibited. Label what you generate as AI-generated. See [ETHICS.md](ETHICS.md).

## Multilingual: 8 languages, native narrators, sentence-by-sentence consistency

We made one Cappadocia documentary video in 8 languages: Turkish, English, French, German, Spanish, Russian, Chinese
and Japanese. Each language has its own **native narrator**, designed with VoxCPM2 from an English description. All of
it was generated fully locally on a 4 GB GTX 1050 Ti, with the same fixed quality (16 steps, cfg 2.0). The seven
narrators are bundled here, with their prompt, design text, seed and reference recording.

name: guizang-tv
description: 归藏电视：适配国内小米电视的简洁 Android 桌面，大字列表、壁纸轮播与 HDMI 直达。
readme:
# 归藏电视 · GuiZang TV

> main 分支提供默认关闭的 [Codex 对话实验](docs/CODEX.md)：在「设置 → 实验性功能 → Codex 对话 → 开启」后显示入口，通过同一局域网电脑连接 Codex。以首页底部输入浮层呈现，带渐变模糊、彩色光效和胶囊消息；支持文字与系统输入法语音（需设备支持），尚未接入米家或个人日程。正式 v0.3.0 APK 不含此功能。

一个给国内小米电视做的简洁桌面：大字、壁纸、常用应用，以及直接进入游戏机和 Apple TV 的入口。

![归藏电视界面示意](docs/preview.svg)

**[下载 v0.3.0 APK](https://github.com/op7418/guizang-tv/releases/latest)** · [兼容性与验证](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) · [代码 MIT 许可](LICENSE)

**v0.3.0：统一设置与全新 Dock。** 壁纸、布局、字体、焦点和首页编辑都在「设置」中；操作见 [设置指南](docs/SETTINGS.md)。横向 Dock 使用宽幅圆角毛玻璃底板和大图标，入口较多时随遥控器焦点平滑滚动。

项目背景见 **[v0.2.0 项目介绍与使用指南](docs/PROJECT-GUIDE.zh-CN.md)**：与 cleanYourTV、CleanFrame 的区别，实际改造与优势，安装、遥控器操作、壁纸设置和源码定制。

这是从个人电视上的定制版本整理出的公开版。目前重点适配小米电视 **MiTV-MTSU0**，不是面向所有 Android TV 的通用桌面替换工具。上图为布局示意；实际内置照片见 [壁纸预览与署名](docs/WALLPAPERS.md)。

**main 天气试用功能（尚未发布 APK）：** 时间右侧可显示天气，支持自动城市与手动选城。默认关闭，开启后联网；[试用说明与数据来源](docs/WEATHER.md)。正式下载仍为 v0.3.0。

## 能做什么

- 左侧大字列表：PlayStation 5、Apple TV、哔哩哔哩、小米投屏、相册、小米原桌面。
- 在已适配机型上，PlayStation 5 直达 HDMI 2，Apple TV 直达 HDMI 1。
- 操作区保留全部应用、其他信号源、设置（列表右下角，Dock 右上角）；壁纸统一进入「设置 → 背景」。
- 设置使用圆角选项与嵌入式首页预览；浏览壁纸时，预览和整页高斯模糊背景同步变化。
- 首页支持列表 / Dock、统一单色 SVG 图标 / 文字、字体风格与字号；毛玻璃焦点按内容宽度包裹，无长条描边。
- 首页 1–9 项，可添加、隐藏、排序和撤销编辑；默认六项不变。
- 壁纸支持固定选择、自动轮播，默认每 5 分钟切换；可选 1 / 5 / 15 / 30 分钟。
- 淡入淡出切换壁纸，离开桌面后暂停计时，返回后重新计时。
- 遥控器方向键操作，记住上次选中的入口和壁纸偏好。
- 基础桌面不需要账号或无障碍服务，不下载或预装视频 App。main 的可选天气和 Codex 实验默认关闭；后者需要电脑上的 Codex 登录及相应额度。v0.3.0 正式版仍不联网。
- 支持实验性开机自动进入：默认关闭，适配机型需先完成一次 ADB 配置，详见 [启用与恢复说明](docs/BOOT-START.md)。

公开版自带五张经过来源核对的 Unsplash 照片：雾中雪岭、雨林山路、热带绿叶、山间彩虹、流光花影。图片适用 [Unsplash License](https://unsplash.com/license)，代码适用 MIT；[完整来源与署名](docs/WALLPAPERS.md)随源码和 APK 保存。其余版权未确认的照片未纳入。也可以用自己的图片构建。

## 安装与使用

从 [Releases](https://github.com/op7418/guizang-tv/releases) 下载 APK，通过电视支持的本地安装方式安装。也可以在开启电视 ADB 调试、电脑连接同一网络后执行：

```sh
adb connect <电视IP>:5555
adb install -r guizang-tv-v0.3.0.apk
```

端口和调试方式取决于电视固件。首次连接请在电视上确认调试授权；使用结束后可以关闭调试。

安装后，在小米原桌面的应用列表中打开 **归藏电视**。

| 遥控器操作 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 上 / 下 | 列表与其操作区切换项目；Dock 向上进入操作区，向下返回应用 |
| 右 | 列表进入操作

name: -mcd-fair-split
readme:
# 麦麦公平账 · McFairSplit

一起点餐，按各自吃的分账。

有人只喝了一杯饮料，有人分走套餐里的汉堡，鸡块大家一起吃。一张订单里的优惠和配送费该怎么算？麦麦公平账先整理餐品归属和大家同意的规则，再算出每人应付多少，并列出计算明细。

当前版本 **0.1.2**。Python 3.10+，只用标准库。可独立运行命令行，也可作为 Skill 使用。独立开发，非麦当劳官方产品。

## 先跑一个例子

```bash
git clone https://github.com/abckkf321/-mcd-fair-split.git mcd-fair-split
cd mcd-fair-split
python3 scripts/cli.py solve --demo four_people --compare equal --html exports/demo.html
```

用浏览器打开 `exports/demo.html`，可以展开每个人的金额来源，查看优惠换一种分法后的差额。示例中的人员、价格、优惠和支付均为合成数据。

四人示例合计 88 元，当前规则下的结果为：

| 小王 | 小李 | 阿青 | 小陈 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 31.74 元 | 23.91 元 | 10.00 元 | 22.35 元 |

另外两个例子：`--demo bundle` 演示两人按 2:1 拆套餐，`--demo one_cent` 演示一分钱的尾分处理。

在支持 `SKILL.md` 的客户端中，将完整目录导入技能目录并启用；`scripts`、`references` 和 `assets` 都需要保留。启用后可以说：

> 用麦麦公平账演示四人拼餐，比较按金额比例和均分优惠，再导出账单。

## 能处理哪些账

- 一笔已付人民币订单，2—10 人，最多 30 个收费行，一人垫付整单。
- 独享餐品、按份数共享的小食，以及按约定比例拆开的套餐。
- 限定商品和人员的优惠，支持按金额比例、均分或指定金额；多项优惠依次处理，分配不会超过适用餐费。
- 配送等费用单独分摊，逐人金额与实付总额核对到分。
- 比较优惠分法，导出 JSON、Markdown 或离线 HTML，保存带版本号的本地账本。

退款、多人垫付、已有转账追踪和在线认领尚未支持。结算页提供转账建议，不执行付款或核验到账。

## 接入自己的订单

在 [麦当劳 MCP 平台](https://open.mcd.cn/mcp) 申请 Token，通过客户端的安全连接设置，或本地进程环境变量 `MCD_MCP_TOKEN` 提供。真实凭证不要写进仓库、命令行参数或分享材料。配置示例里的环境变量占位符需要客户端支持变量替换。

```bash
python3 scripts/cli.py mcp probe
python3 scripts/cli.py mcp orders --out private/orders.json
python3 scripts/cli.py mcp order --id YOUR_ORDER_ID --out private/snapshot.json
```

`probe` 只检查连接。需要找近期订单时使用 `orders`；已有订单号可直接使用 `order`。

导入前，分别核实总额和配送费字符串的单位。如果两者均已确认为元：

```bash
python3 scripts/cli.py draft private/snapshot.json --total-unit yuan --delivery-unit yuan --bill-id lunch-001 --out private/bill.json
```

确认是分的字段使用 `fen`。总额与配送费可以使用不同单位；省略 `--delivery-unit` 时配送费保持待确认。打包费和餐具费按官方字段声明的元转换。不要根据数值大小选择单位。

草稿还需要补齐餐品金额、认领和优惠范围。按 [账单格式](references/bill-format.md) 整理，经用户同意后设置 `rules_confirmed=true`、清空 `unresolved`，再运行：

```bash
python3 scripts/cli.py solve private/bill.json --json private/result.json --markdown private/bill.md --html private/bill.html
python3 scripts/cli.py save private/bill.json --db pri

name: BlazingFastDotnet
description: Tips & tricks to tune .NET workloads for better perf (mostly, targeting benchmarks).
readme:
# Blazing Fast .NET

Tips & tricks to tune .NET 10.0 - 11.0 workloads for better performance (mostly targeting benchmarks), packaged as a single [`SKILL.md`](SKILL.md) for AI coding agents. It reads fine as a regular doc too.

## Usage

I don't expect it to be useful as an always-on skill. It's rather something to consult on demand when you need to optimize a .NET workload, e.g. paste this into your coding agent:

```
Read https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EgorBo/BlazingFastDotnet/main/SKILL.md and use it to
improve the performance of this app. Measure a baseline first, profile to find
the actual bottleneck, apply one change at a time, and keep only changes with a measurable win.
```

> [!NOTE]
> This is not an official Microsoft guide or documentation. Use at your own discretion and always measure performance changes.

## Not welcome in this doc

- Anything that requires an `unsafe` context, under either the unsafe-v1 or the unsafe-v2 rules.
- `ArrayPool<T>`: renting and returning buffers by hand is too error-prone, and I don't want to be responsible for the resulting use-after-return and double-return bugs.
- Third-party dependencies: I'd like to minimize the number of dependencies. Currently, they are limited to:
  - [BenchmarkDotNet](https://github.com/dotnet/BenchmarkDotNet)
  - [FlameGraph](https://github.com/brendangregg/FlameGraph) (for `perf` flame graphs)

name: SuperMimic-Reproduced
description: Reproduction of SuperMimic (arXiv:2610.28480): learned differentiable world model + BPTT policy for G1 humanoid motion tracking, on mjlab/MuJoCo Warp
readme:
# SuperMimic-Reproduced

> **English summary.** An independent from-scratch reproduction of *SuperMimic* (arXiv:2610.28480): a learned differentiable world model plus short-horizon BPTT actor-critic for Unitree G1 whole-body motion tracking, built on [mjlab](https://github.com/mujocolab/mjlab) / MuJoCo Warp. Includes the data pipeline (LAFAN1, BONES-SEED 129.9k clips), differentiable FK and analytic reward heads, the world model and imagination trainer, torchrun data-parallel training, the Appendix-F benchmark, and an interactive replay viewer. On LAFAN1 it reaches the paper's 0.82 tracking score in 1.66 h on one RTX 5090 (with anchor-relative observations; paper-observation runs are in progress). Documentation is in Chinese; see `docs/` for the paper spec, plan, review log and experiment log.

从零复现论文 **SuperMimic: Scaling Humanoid Whole-Body Control with One Differentiable World Model**（[arXiv:2610.28480](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28480)，CoRL 2026）：一个学习得到的可微世界模型 + 短视野 BPTT actor-critic，用于 Unitree G1 人形全身动作跟踪。底座是 [mjlab](https://github.com/mujocolab/mjlab)（MuJoCo Warp），固定到 commit `8bb2bc9`；不使用 rsl_rl，世界模型、BPTT 训练器、多 clip 动作库、基于回报的重置采样、评测全部自己实现。

> 状态（2026-10-21）：LAFAN1 上达到论文量级（M3），BONES-SEED 全量数据管线与单卡训练完成，多卡训练已跑通；正式结果正在按论文观测口径重跑（e6/e7）。详见 [docs/EXPERIMENTS.md](docs/EXPERIMENTS.md)。

## 结果速览

评测协议为论文 Appendix F：每条 clip 从首帧整条确定性播放、无噪声无域随机化，**归一化回报** = Σ每步奖励 / (0.1 × 步数)，1.0 为完美跟踪；"失败" = 训练终止条件触发。

| 实验 | 数据 | 硬件 | 观测口径 | 训练时长 | 评测回报 | 失败 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 论文 Fig. 4a | LAFAN1 40 clip | 1×H100 | 论文 | 1.2 h | 0.82 | – |
| e2 | LAFAN1 40 clip | 1×5090 | **论文** | 1.8 h | 0.56 | 9/40 |
| e3 | LAFAN1 40 clip | 1×5090 | +锚点相对位姿 | 1.66 h / 3.3 h | 0.824 / **0.904** | 5/40 / 3/40 |
| 论文 Table A.8 | BONES-SEED 129.5k clip | 1×H100 | 论文 | 3 h | >0.90 | 25/129,514 |
| e5 | BONES-SEED 129.9k clip | 1×5090 | +锚点相对位姿 | 4.2 h / 5.8 h | 0.934 / 0.935（2000 条子集） | 6/2000 / 5/2000 |
| e6 / e7 | LAFAN1 40 clip | 3×5090 / 1×5090 | **论文** | 进行中 | – | – |

- 世界模型 8 步开环归一化误差 0

name: mcd-self-butler
description: 麦当劳自助管家 McButler — 基于麦当劳 MCP 的点单参谋：每日推荐 / 套餐健康体检 / 门店全成本比价 / 团餐智能配餐 / 麦险分信用评级 / 麦门小剧场。麦当劳 1024 程序员节参赛作品。
readme:
# 麦当劳自助管家 · McButler

> 一个基于麦当劳官方 MCP 的点单参谋：**帮你把「省钱」「健康」「省时间」三个约束同时解开**，
> 顺便用信贷评分卡的思路给你打个「麦险分」，并在等餐的三分钟里放一场五个小人吵架的小剧场。

参赛：麦当劳程序员节创意开发大赛 · 开发 Skill 赛道
MCP：`https://mcp.mcd.cn`（Streamable HTTP）

**在线体验小剧场** → https://jouaaaaaa.github.io/mcd-self-butler/demo/theater.html
**仓库** → https://github.com/jouaaaaaa/mcd-self-butler

![麦门小剧场](docs/theater.png)

---

## 一、它到底解决什么问题

不是「推荐一个套餐」这么简单。真实场景里，用户同时被三件事夹着：

| 场景 | 用户的真实处境 | 大多数工具的做法 | McButler 的做法 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **午休只有 40 分钟** | 想快、想吃好、不想多花钱 | 按价格排序 | 算「全成本」：商品价 + 走路时间 + 排队时间 |
| **在减脂但嘴馋** | 想要能吃的数据，不是「少吃点」 | 甩一个热量数字 | 拆套餐 → 逐项对营养表 → 给可执行的替换方案 |
| **部门 30 人团餐** | 预算、忌口、口味全都不一样 | 报一个总价 | 分群配餐，输出可直接算价的 `items` |

一句话：**别人帮你选一个餐，McButler 帮你把这一餐的所有约束一次性对平。**

---

## 二、六个能力

| # | 能力 | 命令 | 一句话说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 每日推荐 | `recommend` | 省钱 / 健康 / 人气三种模式，各自一套排序逻辑 |
| 2 | 健康体检 | `health` | 把套餐拆成子项逐项对表，输出热量·蛋白·脂肪·钠·钙 + 扣分明细 |
| 3 | 门店比价 | `stores` | 最近 / 最便宜 / 综合全成本 |
| 4 | 团餐配餐 | `bulk` | 按忌口与口味分群，N 人份自动配比，输出可直接下单的 items |
| 5 | 麦险分 | `credit` | 六维信贷评分卡，账户级 + 订单级双评级 |
| 6 | 麦门小剧场 | `theater` | 五个小人用你的券和信用分吵架，吵出最省钱方案 |

### 1. 每日推荐

三种模式不是换个排序字段，而是三套不同的价值函数：

- **省钱**：`0.55 × 价格归一 + 0.30 × 折扣力度 + 0.15 × 每 100kcal 单价`
  —— 用「每 100 kcal 多少钱」防止用小食刷低价格。
- **健康**：`0.75 × 健康分 + 0.25 × 能量贴合度`，并对有实测数据的候选加权 3 分。
- **人气**：`0.7 × 热度 + 0.3 × 折扣`，热度 = 爆款标签 + 你的历史常点。

### 2. 健康体检（本项目的技术核心）

麦当劳的营养接口只给**单品**，不给套餐。所以任何「巨无霸三件套 949 kcal」都必须自己算：

```
query-meal-detail("巨无霸三件套")
  └─ rounds[isDefault=1] → 巨无霸 / 中薯条 / 可乐中杯
      └─ list-nutrition-foods 逐项查表
          └─ 513 + 289 + 147 = 949 kcal · 钠 1126mg · 蛋白 31g
```

评分是 100 分制扣分：能量区间(30) + 蛋白质(20) + 脂肪供能比(20) + 钠(20) + 糖油负担(16) + 蔬果加分(+10)。
完整公式见 [`references/model-spec.md`](references/model-spec.md)。

**并且明确标注数据质量**：`实测` / `官方` / `估`。拿不到数据就不给分（`健康分 —`），绝不编数字。

### 3. 门店比价：我们不打价格战，我们打全成本

```
全成本 = 商品价 + 距离成本(往返 0.5 元/km) + 时间成本((步行往返 + 排队) × 0.30 元/分钟)
```

readme:
# unthemidator

[![@x86rc](https://img.shields.io/badge/%40x86rc-000000?style=flat&logo=x&logoColor=white)](https://x.com/x86rc)
[![Discord Server](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord%20Server-503010?style=flat&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/Dvcj2qQVsg)

A universal unpacker for Themida-protected binaries and runtime protection removal tool. 
Unthemidator does **NOT** run the binary, nor does it call any APIs or execute syscalls used by target binaries 
on the host machine.

Unthemidator works with all kinds of Windows binaries (dll, exe, sys and others) in both x86 (32-bit) 
and x86_64 / amd64 (64-bit) variations.

After unpacking, a full PE rebuild is performed, making the unpacked binary runnable and debuggable.

In addition to unpacking and PE rebuilding, Unthemidator can identify the version of 
Themida / Code Virtualizer virtual machines used in binaries.

## Features

- [x] Full PE unpacking
- [x] Resource unpacking
- [x] Virtual machine decompression
- [x] Import decryption and IAT restoration
- [x] Themida/Code Virtualizer version identification
- [x] Location of all Themida/CV entry points

## How to

Simply drag and drop a packed binary onto unthemidator or use the following CLI command on Windows:
```bash
unthemidator.exe [options] {path_to_bin.exe|.dll|.sys|.bin}
```
and the following CLI command on a Unix-based system:
```bash
./unthemidator [options] {path_to_bin.exe|.dll|.sys|.bin}
```

A PE will only be considered a kernel driver if its file extension is **.sys**. 
This is done to ensure correct parsing of files with any extensions as usermode applications by default. 
Not to mention that packed kernel drivers are extremely rare and can only run on insecure systems.

#### Options

Below is a complete overview of all unthemidator options.

- `--out-file` - output file name / path. Defaults to `{program_name}.unpacked.{program_extension}`
- `--imports-file` - name (or path) of the file to save information about imports to. Should b

readme:
# BotW Recompiled for Windows

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1b7d6766-425b-4e4b-833a-cb3c60369226

Breath of the Wild (Wii U) running on **Windows 10 and Windows 11** with Vulkan. The
PowerPC game code is statically recompiled to C++ and runs on a Cafe OS runtime. Cemu's Latte
GPU layer draws through Vulkan. There is no emulator and no JIT. This is work in progress and
not a full-game release.

## What works

Tested on a recent NVIDIA laptop GPU, from a USA v208 (1.5.0) game folder, at about
60 fps:

- the opening
- audio
- the title screen with the logo
- loading a save
- combat
- the map and fast travel
- Hateno Village, with NPCs and shops

Not working or not confirmed yet:
- Some effects, parts of the controller mapping, and some cutscene text are unconfirmed or
  incomplete.
- Everything not listed above has not been checked. See [Known issues](#known-issues).

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This repository contains no game files, no keys, and no decryption tools. You must supply
> your own legally obtained copy of the game, as an already-extracted game folder (`code/`,
> `content/`, `meta/`). Nothing here is a download for the game. This is an unofficial fan
> project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo.

## Requirements

- Windows 10 or Windows 11, and a GPU with a Vulkan 1.1 driver. The verified machine has
  a recent NVIDIA laptop GPU.
- [MSYS2](https://www.msys2.org/) with the **UCRT64** environment. The Cafe runtime uses
  pthreads, so the build is MinGW gcc. MSVC and clang-cl are not supported.
- Your own legally obtained **Breath of the Wild for Wii U, USA, with update v208 (1.5.0)**,
  as an already-extracted game folder. The recompiler and the game patches match that

# McReplay · 麦回放

**把一次麦当劳 MCP 查询变成可复现的本地结构测试。**

面向维护麦当劳 MCP Skill、解析器和演示应用的个人开发者：删除响应真实值，保留结构，比较变化，再通过标准 MCP 在本地回放。

![结构变化报告](docs/demo-report.png)

## 解决什么问题

“昨天能解析，今天为什么空了？”字段类型改变、活动字段消失、文本返回变空，都可能让已有解析器失效。McReplay 把这些变化变成可定位、可复现的测试结果。

开发流程：在 AI 客户端中查询 → 本地提取结构 → 比较变化 → 回放样本，运行适配器回归测试。

- **结构观察包**：识别完整 JSON、代码围栏 JSON、`## Original Response` 后的 JSON，以及未解析文本与空文本。
- **变化检测**：工具删除、必填参数增加、字段消失、类型和封装变化；区分 `breaking`、`review`、`info`。
- **本地 MCP 回放**：官方 Python MCP SDK、stdio 协议；复用已记录的三种只读工具。
- **本地接收工具与 Skill**：接收一次正常官方查询的结果，在内存中删除原值后写入文件。
- **可用于 CI**：离线命令、明确退出码和独立 HTML 报告。

支持的工具包括 `now-time-info`、`campaign-calendar`、`list-nutrition-foods`。三项工具已于 2026-10-24 完成官方认证查询、结构提取与本地 MCP 回放验证，详见 [实测记录](docs/LIVE_VERIFICATION.md)。

## 30 秒离线试用

运行环境：Python 3.11+，Linux 或 macOS。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/YoyoLin008/mcreplay.git
cd mcreplay
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e .
mcreplay demo --out-dir demo-output
```

打开 `demo-output/report.html`，查看三处预设的结构变化。演示使用合成样本；每次运行选择一个新输出目录。

```bash
mcreplay compare demo-output/before.json demo-output/after.json
# 该演示包含破坏性变化，因此 compare 预期退出码为 2。
```

可运行 `python examples/check_adapter.py demo-output/before.json` 查看独立 SDK 适配器通过；将文件换成 `after.json` 会检测到刻意加入的类型变化并退出 2。

退出码：`0` 无变化或仅信息项；`2` 有破坏性风险；`3` 仅需人工复核；`1` 输入或执行失败。

## 回放官方实测结构

仓库附带由三项官方查询提取的结构样本，可直接运行：

```bash
python examples/check_recorded_structure.py
```

该检查通过标准 MCP 客户端完成三项样本的接收和回放，并验证时间、活动及营养响应的字段格式。

### 1. 修改解析器前，先比较样本

```bash
mcreplay import private/export-before.json --out private/before.json

mcreplay compare private/before.json private/after.json --html private/report.html

readme:
# Arn0 Launcher

A quieter home screen for a Samsung Tizen TV: a clock, a row of your apps, a row of your consoles,
and nothing else.

![The launcher on the "Milky Way" wallpaper, showing the clock, an apps row and a consoles row](docs/preview.png)

*The browser preview, with the bundled Manrope font and the "Milky Way" wallpaper.*

I built this for one TV in my living room, a Samsung Q70B on Tizen 6.5, because its own home
screen had become a shop. It does what I want: the apps I use, the consoles I own, driven by the normal remote. I am sharing it as a starting point rather than a product.

**Use it at your own risk.** The optional Home-button setup changes TV preferences that Samsung
does not document. See [the setup guide](docs/setup-tv.md) before using it.

## Recommended approach

I highly recommend forking it and building on top of it, ideally with a coding agent that can help
you understand and adapt the setup. Start with the browser preview, make the interface your own,
then work through TV installation when you're ready. Native Home/startup changes need particular
care; [the setup guide](docs/setup-tv.md) covers the risks and recovery steps.

## Try the interface

Needs Node.js 20 or newer. Nothing is installed and no TV is involved.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/<you>/arn0-tv.git
cd arn0-tv
npm run preview        # http://localhost:8080
```

Navigate with the arrow keys and Enter; Esc or Backspace is Back; `R` `G` `Y` `B` are the remote's
colour keys. `#all` and `#lab` in the URL open those screens directly.

The preview runs against [`src/js/tizen-mock.js`](src/js/tizen-mock.js), a stand-in for the Tizen
APIs that is inert on the TV itself. So the layout, focus behaviour, settings, fonts and wallpapers
are all real, while launching apps and switching HDMI inputs only do something on a real TV.

## What you can change

Everything in [`src/js/config.js`](src/js/config.js) is meant to be edited: which apps appear, which
consoles and on which HDMI port

name: opal
description: OPAL: a reactive optimizer. A coding agent rewrites the optimizer while your model trains.
readme:
OPAL: a reactive optimizer

A PyTorch optimizer wrapper that lets a coding agent change the optimizer while your model trains.

Blog post · Guide · Start with your agent · Examples

Most networks are trained with an optimizer that is fixed before training starts. OPAL (OPtimizer with an Agent in the Loop) turns the optimizer into a program that an agent keeps rewriting during the run. You wrap your PyTorch optimizer in one line. Every so often the agent (Claude Code) reads what the run reports and decides whether to rewrite two small programs: the optimizer program, which turns gradients into updates at every step, and an analysis program, which measures whatever the agent wants to look at. The agent can change anything that can be written as optimizer code: the update rule of each parameter group, the learning rates and their schedules, momentum and β₂, preconditioning, clipping, guards against loss spikes. It is asked not to touch your model, data, loss, batch size, number of steps or evaluation. Its programs run inside your training process, so this is a rule, not a sandbox (see [Safety](https://github.com/xingjian-bai/opal/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#safety)). Until the agent changes something, the wrapped run is bit-for-bit the same as the plain one. ## Start with your coding agent Open your own project in a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar) and paste this prompt. The agent installs OPAL, wires it into your training script, asks you what it cannot know, and checks that nothing changed before anything costs money. ```text I want to train my model with OPAL, a reactive optimizer: a coding agent that rewrite

先看效果 · 安装使用 · 如何工作 · 使用问答

## 先看效果 **同一顿饭，换个买法能省多少？** 适合想知道自己常点的组合有没有更便宜买法、犹豫要不要为满减凑单的用户。 | 你现在想做什么 | 从这里开始 | |---|---| | 看看差价报告 | 查看[示例](examples/demo-quotes.json)：不同买法的核价对比 | | 用自己的门店核价 | [安装Skill](#安装使用)，连接自己的麦当劳MCP | 每次核价后自动生成`audit-report.html`，可以调预算、看差价、复制结果。报告只包含本轮有效报价，不联网。 ## 真实案例 > 帮我体检一下：巨无霸+中薯条+中可乐 ``` 按单点算：45元 | 买法 | 实付 | 比原样省 | |---|---:|---:| | 巨无霸套餐+立减5元 | 34.5 | 10.5 | | 单点+满40减8 | 37 | 8 | | 单点 | 39 | 6 | 最优：巨无霸套餐+立减5元，实付34.5元，省10.5元。 凑单体检：满45减6还差10.5，最少加购14元才够， 只减6元→净亏8元，不建议凑。 ``` | 还可以这样问 | 它会处理什么 | |---|---| | 不要可乐，汉堡保留 | 替换后对完整餐单重新核价 | | 满60减12要不要凑 | 算加购临界点，判断净赚还是净亏 | | 复盘最近订单 | 用历史订单对比所有买法 | ## 安装使用 需要支持远程MCP的AI客户端（WorkBuddy、Cherry Studio、Cursor等），以及麦当劳MCP Token。配套脚本需要Python 3.10+，使用标准库，无第三方依赖。 1. 到[麦当劳MCP平台](https://open.mcd.cn/mcp)登录、激活Token，连接`https://mcp.mcd.cn`，协议Streamable HTTP。 2. 下载并解压仓库。WorkBuddy运行`./install.ps1`，或导入`skills/mcd-saver-checkup`文件夹。 3. 新开会话，发送： ```text 使用麦门省钱体检技能。帮我体检：巨无霸+中薯条+中可乐。 用我的麦当劳MCP枚举所有买法，逐个核价，报差额和凑单临界点。不下单。 ``` [详细点击步骤](docs/quick-start.md) ## 如何工作 AI负责理解需求、查询真实菜单和枚举候选买法；官方`calculate-price`返回整单应付金额；本地脚本按整数分检查预算、份数、去重和排序。 | 容易卡住的地方 | 怎样处理 | |---|---| | 看得到套餐价，不清楚实际组成 | 核对套餐轮次、替换项与实际数量 | | 换了餐品，还在沿用旧价格 | 每次修改都重新核价 | | 不知道省在套餐还是券 | 逐项归因：套餐、券、满减各贡献多少 | | 为满减凑单可能亏 | 算加购临界点，判断净赚还是净亏 | | 后面的接口失败，前面结果丢了 | 停止后续请求，保留成功报价 | | 报告导出失败 | 从comparison.json离线恢复 | ## 验证记录 | 范围 | 验证内容 | |---|---| | Python逻辑 | 离线回归，含预算检查、去重、导出失败恢复 | | 页面逻辑 | 模拟DOM场景，含复制回退、结果清理 | | 安装升级 | 临时配置目录检查，含旧文件清理、私人记录保留 | ## 使用问答

name: douyin-to-obsidian
description: A portable /dy skill for cc-connect + Claude Code: Douyin videos, image posts and collections to Obsidian, with local ASR/OCR and private configuration.
readme:
# douyin-to-obsidian

把抖音视频、图文和收藏夹中的知识整理到自己的 Obsidian。面向 **cc-connect + Claude Code** 的 /dy 技能：Python 负责材料获取、本地识别、查重和事务写入，当前会话的模型负责理解、纠错和知识提炼。

Douyin videos, image posts and collections → structured Obsidian notes. Full support: Apple Silicon macOS, Chrome, Python 3.12 and a configured cc-connect Claude Code workspace.

## 能做什么

- 导入单个作品、分享口令或多个链接；收藏夹只补充尚未入库的作品。
- 视频使用本地 MLX Whisper 转写；图文逐页 Apple Vision OCR，再由支持读图的模型核对原图。
- 按主题生成知识笔记、自测和有依据的模型补充，附上原作品链接。
- 用作品 ID 查重；已有笔记改名、移动后仍能识别，不覆盖其正文或个人修改。
- 笔记、图文附件、知识总索引、导入总日志通过同一事务提交，失败时回滚。
- 保留批次状态、有限浏览器恢复、清单缺口和逐条失败链接；不无限重试。
- 粘贴包含“复制打开抖音”的分享口令可以自动路由；普通讨论或明确拒绝导入时不启动导入。

这不是独立的自动摘要服务。只运行 Python 不会代替模型生成知识正文；宿主需要 Read、Write、命令执行和读图能力。公开视频也可能受平台接口、网络或权限限制，不能保证任意链接均可访问。

## 环境要求

| 项目 | 要求 |
| --- | --- |
| 系统 | Apple Silicon Mac；Intel Mac、Windows、Linux 未验证，不提供完整支持 |
| Python | 3.12；安装命令使用你自己的解释器绝对路径 |
| Node.js | 本机可执行的 Node.js，供 F2 的 JavaScript 签名使用 |
| Chrome | 已安装，使用你自己的用户资料；私人收藏夹需要该资料已登录抖音 |
| OCR | Xcode Command Line Tools，包含 xcrun 和 Swift |
| 宿主 | 已配置好模型和渠道的 cc-connect，后端为 Claude Code |
| Obsidian | 已存在、可读写的 Vault；无须额外 Obsidian 插件 |

安装器只配置所选工作区的 /dy 技能、命令与路由 Hook，不配置模型账号或聊天渠道。先参照 [cc-connect 官方说明](https://github.com/chenhg5/cc-connect) 完成宿主配置。

如果尚未安装 Command Line Tools，可在终端运行：

~~~sh
xcode-select --install
~~~

## 1. 下载

在 GitHub 页面选择 Code → Download ZIP，解压后进入目录；也可以：

~~~sh
git clone https://github.com/llm-xiaoye/douyin-to-obsidian.git
cd douyin-to-obsidian
~~~

建议使用 [Releases](https://github.com/llm-xiaoye/douyin-to-obsidian/releases) 中的版本。ZIP 与 Git clone 使用相同安装步骤。

## 2. 确定自己的路径

你需要提供：

1. **cc-connect 工作区**：该项目中 Claude Code 实际使用的 work_dir，不是 cc-connect 程序目录。
2. **Obsidian Vault**：你的知识库根目录，里面可以已有其他笔记。
3. **Chrome Profile**：在用于登录抖音的 Chrome 中打开 chrome://version，复制“个人资料路径 / Profile Path”。例如 Default 或 Profile 1 所在的完整目录，不能只填用户数据父目录。

默认 Chrome 数据目录可自动推导对应缓存。自定义 --user-data-dir 必须另传 --browser-cache-dir，指向同一资料的 Cache_Data。安装器不会创建 Chrome Profile、复制 Cookie 或要求你导出登录凭据。

name: AARE
description: A proof-of-concept opensource implementation of Android Auto's client side (phone side)
readme:
# AARE

AARE is an open-source reimplementation of the phone side of Android Auto. The phone talks the
Android Auto projection protocol (AAP) to the car's head unit, draws the car screen itself, and
runs apps that Google's Android Auto keeps out:

- **Navigation:** CoMaps, Organic Maps and other apps built with the AndroidX Car App Library,
  F-Droid builds included.
- **Media:** Tempus (Subsonic/Navidrome) and any app with a media3 or `MediaBrowserService`
  library: podcasts, radio, local players.
- **Messaging:** WhatsApp, Signal, SMS and any app whose notifications Android Auto can read:
  conversations read aloud, marked as read, answered with the car keyboard when parked.
- **Voice assistant:** the steering-wheel voice button opens the phone's default digital
  assistant, or another one you pick. Assistants with a car app, such as
  [Lapin](https://github.com/prototux/lapin), run on the car screen and hear the car's microphone.

It needs no Google Play Services.

![The car screen: CoMaps guiding, the music, and the bar along the bottom](docs/screenshots/main.png)

> [!WARNING]
> **This is early software.** The protocol stack is tested against a simulated head unit, against
> AARE's own desktop head unit and against Google's Desktop Head Unit up to the certificate check
> (see below). So far it has been tried in one real car, over wireless (see
> [Tested on real head units](#tested-on-real-head-units)). Don't depend on it while driving
> until you have tried it in yours.

## What works

| Part | State |
|---|---|
| Protocol: framing, TLS 1.2 (phone = server), version, service discovery, channels | done, unit and loopback tests |
| Video: H.264 hardware encoding of a private virtual display, ack flow control, focus, key-frame recovery | done |
| Adaptive video bitrate: lower when the car or a weak wireless link falls behind, back up when it catches up | new, untested on hardware |
| Portrait head units: bottom bar, stacked dashboard, CarPlay mode | new, tested o

name: Cloudflare-Tunnel-Panel
description: 一个用cloudflare workers部署的多账号隧道管理面板
readme:
# Cloudflare Tunnel 管理面板

Cloudflare Worker部署的Argo tunnel网页管理面板，用于管理多账户下的 Argo Tunnel：新建/编辑/删除隧道、查看连接 Token、增删域名路由、查看在线状态，并可选地把隧道上线/离线事件通过 Telegram 推送提醒。

整个项目只有 **一个文件**：`_worker.js`（Worker 代码 + 内嵌管理页面，无需构建、无外部依赖）,之前部署了旧的版本，只需要复制_worker.js里的代码替换部署即可，其他的都不变

## 功能一览

- **密码登录**：访问面板需输入密码，会话 Cookie 签名有效期 7 天，登录接口有防爆破延时。
- **多账号管理**：顶栏下拉切换 Cloudflare 账号；可在"账号管理"里添加多个账号（各自 API Token，验证后存 D1）；环境变量配置的账号作为默认账号。隧道列表、路由、提醒规则、定时检查均按账号隔离。
- **隧道管理**：列表展示所有隧道及状态（在线/降级/离线/未启用 + 运行时长）、搜索过滤、查看启动 Token、修改名称与本地服务地址（多路由可选要编辑的那条）、删除隧道。
- **新建隧道**：选择域名 (Zone)、子域名、可选路径、本地服务地址（如 `http://localhost:8080`、`tcp://localhost:22`），自动创建隧道并自动配置 DNS CNAME 记录。
- **多路由管理**：在已有隧道上增删"域名 + 路径 → 服务"的 ingress 规则（每条隧道最多 60 条），自动处理 DNS，冲突时拒绝写入。
- **Telegram 上下线提醒**：状态**发生变化**才推送（上线一次、离线一次），可按隧道逐个开关（**默认关闭**）；支持多个接收者（私聊/群组/频道）、暂停/恢复推送。
- **PWA**：可安装到桌面/手机主屏，带离线壳页面。

## 快速部署（Cloudflare Dashboard）

1. 登录 [Cloudflare Dashboard](https://dash.cloudflare.com) → **Workers & Pages** → **Create** → 创建 Worker，把 `_worker.js` 内容全部粘贴进去，保存。
2. **【非必须】绑定 D1数据库管理多账号**：参考下方D1数据库的设置
3. **【必须】配置环境变量**：Settings → Variables and Secrets，添加 `CF_API_TOKEN`、`CF_ACCOUNT_ID`、`PASSWORD`（详见下表）。
4. 部署后打开 `https://<Worker 域名>`，输入密码登录即可。


## 环境变量

| 变量 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CF_API_TOKEN` | ✅ | API 令牌。权限见下方「API Token 权限配置」 |
| `CF_ACCOUNT_ID` | ✅ | Cloudflare 账户 ID,创建token时会显示 |
| `PASSWORD` | ✅ | 面板登录密码，至少 6 位 |
| `SESSION_SECRET` | 建议 | 会话签名密钥，一串随机字符。不设置时由密码派生（改密码会使所有人重新登录） |
| `TUNNEL_STATE` | 可选 | **KV 命名空间绑定**（Bindings，不是环境变量），存储登录外的全部状态与提醒配置。**推荐改用 D1**：绑定变量名 `TUNNEL_DB`（建表见下），两者同时绑定时 D1 优先 |
| `DEFAULT_SERVICE` | 可选 | 新建/编辑隧道时的默认本地服务地址，如 `http://localhost:8080` |
| `TG_BOT_TOKEN` | 可选 | Telegram 机器人 Token（环境变量兜底；也可在面板里保存到 D1） |
| `TG_CHAT_ID` | 可选 | 默认接收者 chat_id（环境变量兜底） |

## API Token 权限配置

创建 API Token（My Profile → API Tokens → Create Token → Custom token）时，按下面两组勾选。注意区分**账户级（整个账户）**和**区域级（所有域名/Zone Resources 选 All zones）**两组，名字相近但作用完全不同：

**账户级（Account Resources 选整个账户）：**

| 分组 | 权限项 | 级别 |
| --- | --- | --- |

readme:
# ELYTerminal

A terminal for macOS, Windows and Linux, in Rust on GPUI and Ely components. Sessions sit on the left, the terminal in the middle, Git or Files on the right. Every setting has a control in the settings window.

## Install

A [release on GitHub](https://github.com/ELY-Open-Source/ELYTerminal/releases) carries builds for each platform.

- macOS 11 or later, Apple silicon: open `ELYTerminal-VERSION.dmg` and drag ELYTerminal into Applications. The app is signed with Developer ID and notarized.
- Windows 10 or later, x86_64: unzip `ELYTerminal-VERSION-windows-x86_64.zip` and run `elyterminal.exe`. It is unsigned; if SmartScreen stops it, press More info, then Run anyway.
- Linux, x86_64: choose a package below.

### Linux

Replace `VERSION` with the release's version. Linux builds need glibc 2.35 or
later, an X11 or Wayland desktop and working graphics drivers. Native packages
install the runtime libraries, desktop entry and icon through the package manager.
The formats below can be built with `scripts/linux-packages.sh`. Use the assets
actually listed for your selected release; packaging CI artifacts are separate
downloads.

On Ubuntu 22.04, Ubuntu 24.04 or Debian 12:

```sh
sudo apt install ./elyterminal_VERSION_amd64.deb
```

On Fedora 43:

```sh
sudo dnf install ./elyterminal-VERSION-1.x86_64.rpm
```

Install a newer package the same way to update. To remove it, use
`sudo apt remove elyterminal` or `sudo dnf remove elyterminal`.
Package operations leave `~/.config/ELYTerminal` alone.

The AppImage runs without a system installation:

```sh
chmod +x ELYTerminal-VERSION-linux-x86_64.AppImage
./ELYTerminal-VERSION-linux-x86_64.AppImage
```

It bundles the keyboard libraries, but uses the host's glibc, X11/Wayland and
graphics libraries, and installed fonts. Install `git`, `curl` and `xdg-utils`
on the host for Git, update checks and desktop links. Without FUSE, run
`./ELYTerminal-VERSION-linux-x86_64.AppImage --appimage-extract-and-run`.
